newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Endemol's "Titanic" receipts double after prizes.
newsitem.headline: Endemol's "Titanic" receipts double after prizes.

text.p: Endemol NV said on Thursday that "Titanic" -- the Broadway musical co-produced by its 50-50 U.S. joint-venture Dodger Endemol -- had doubled its daily receipts to about $150,000 since winning five Tony awards.
Chief financial officer Aat Schouwenaar said the extra interest generated since the awards were announced at the beginning of June had made Titanic one of the top three musicals running on Broadway.
The Tonys had also led to inquiries about staging the show, which is about the 1912 sinking of the luxury liner Titanic, in Britain and Japan.
Endemol is one of Europe's top two independent television production companies, but generates roughly a quarter of its revenues from live entertainment -- mainly stage musicals and ice-skating shows.
